# P-Clock

A secure, private Windows clock app with cosmic themes, meditation sounds,
productivity timers, and encrypted local storage.

## Features

- 🕐 World Clock, Timer, Stopwatch, Alarm
- 🍅 Pomodoro & Interval Timer
- 🧘 Meditation with ambient sound engine
- 😴 Sleep Tracker with stats
- 📊 Statistics & Achievements
- 🔐 PIN Lock + AES-256-GCM encrypted database
- 🎨 7 cosmic themes, custom video/image background
- 🚀 Auto-update via GitHub Releases

## Download

Get the latest version from [Releases](https://github.com/topbd5555-max/p-clock/releases).

## Build from source

```bash
npm install
npm run electron:dev      # development
npm run electron:release  # production build
